skills.name: release-check
skills.description: How to verify a release before tagging it: build, tests, changelog, and the smoke run.
skills.body:
## When

Before you tag a release or open the release pull request.

## Steps

1. `git fetch --tags` and make sure the tree is clean.
2. Run the project's verify command and the smoke run described in its README.
3. Compare `CHANGELOG.md` against `git log --oneline LAST_TAG..HEAD`; every user-visible change gets a line.
4. Bump the version in one commit, nothing else in it.

## Check

The verify command exits 0 and the changelog mentions the version you are about to tag.

skills.name: demo-app-local-setup
skills.description: Bringing demo-app up locally: the env file, the seed database, the two ports.
skills.body:
## When

Any job that runs demo-app end to end.

## Steps

1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`; leave `DATABASE_URL` as it is, the seed script creates the file.
2. `npm ci` then `npm run seed` once per checkout.
3. `npm run dev` listens on 3000 (web) and 3001 (api). If 3001 is taken, set `API_PORT`; do not edit the code.

## Check

`curl -s localhost:3001/health` answers `{"ok":true}`.

skills.name: flaky-test-triage
skills.description: Deciding whether a failing test is flaky, and what to record either way.
skills.body:
## When

A test fails that you did not touch.

## Steps

1. Run it alone three times. All pass: flaky. Any fail: real.
2. Flaky: open a FINDING with the test name and the three runs; do not retry the suite more than once.
3. Real: bisect against the base commit before blaming your change.

## Check

Your report says which of the two it was and shows the evidence.

skills.name: release
skills.description: How to cut a release of demo-app: tag, notes, the smoke run.
skills.body:
# Release

1. Tag the commit `vX.Y.Z` and push the tag.
2. Write the notes from `git log --oneline LAST..HEAD`.
3. Run the smoke run the README describes.

Support files beside this SKILL.md in the repository: checklist.md.
